strings.name: Christophe Fouquet
strings.summary: Christophe Fouquet is a French semiconductor-equipment executive who led ASML’s Applications, EUV and overall business operations before becoming president and CEO in 2024. His work connects industrialisation, customer needs and company management; lithography advances are the work of teams and partners.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Management and Supervisory Boards, appointment and start in office, and forecasts and achieved results are distinguished. Birth year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Contributed to ASML’s EUV technology and company management, influencing the development of advanced semiconductor-manufacturing equipment.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Holds a master’s degree in physics from the Institut Polytechnique de Grenoble.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early career
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked at Applied Materials and KLA Tencor before joining ASML.
strings.highlights.h1.title: EUV business leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led the EUV business from 2018 to 2022, contributing to its industrialisation; team achievements are not attributed to him alone.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Corporate governance
strings.highlights.h2.text: Serves as ASML president and CEO and joined the Airbus board as a non-executive director in 2026; the roles belong to separate companies.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discusses quarterly results and capacity
strings.timeline.t1.text: In the third-quarter results release, discusses customer demand and expansion; supply assessments for 2027–2028 remain forward-looking.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joins the Airbus board
strings.timeline.t2.text: Co-opted as a non-executive director to complete René Obermann’s term; a full three-year term in 2027 still requires an AGM decision.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes ASML president and CEO
strings.timeline.t3.text: The annual report dates his appointment to April 24; a company story dates his start to April 25. Succeeds Peter Wennink as CEO.
strings.timeline.t4.title: CEO succession plan announced
strings.timeline.t4.text: The Supervisory Board announces its intention to appoint him as the next president and CEO; he has not yet taken office.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes chief business officer
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moves from EUV to broader business management, serving as chief business officer until 2024.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Leads EUV and joins Management Board
strings.timeline.t6.text: Becomes executive vice president EUV and a Management Board member, not yet chief business officer.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Takes charge of Applications
strings.timeline.t7.text: Begins serving as executive vice president Applications, a role held until 2018.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins ASML
strings.timeline.t8.text: Works in marketing and product management before moving into business leadership.
